from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs/task-44ca675d.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    cells = {(r,c): grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg}
    unseen = set(cells)
    comps = []
    while unseen:
        start = unseen.pop()
        stack = [start]
        comp = {start}
        while stack:
            r,c = stack.pop()
            for dr in (-1,0,1):
                for dc in (-1,0,1):
                    q = (r+dr,c+dc)
                    if q in unseen:
                        unseen.remove(q); comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    template = max(comps, key=len)
    rs = [r for r,c in template]; cs = [c for r,c in template]
    ar, ac = (min(rs)+max(rs))//2, (min(cs)+max(cs))//2
    shape = [(r-ar,c-ac,cells[(r,c)]) for r,c in template]
    targets = [pos for pos in cells if pos not in template]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in template:
        out[r][c] = bg
    for r,c in targets:
        for dr,dc,color in shape:
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
